migration_flags.description: The procurement.group model no longer exists in Odoo 19 Community. Any migration code referencing group_id FK or procurement.group must be rewritten to use stock.reference via reference_ids Many2many on stock.move.
migration_flags.evidence: stock/models/stock_picking.py:590-591 + grep of all stock models — no procurement.group _name found

migration_flags.description: stock.picking.reference_ids is a Many2many to stock.reference (related from move_ids.reference_ids). Old group_id field on stock.picking is absent. Migration must map group_id references to reference_ids.

The immediate_transfer Boolean field and _check_immediate() method on stock.picking are absent in v19. Immediate-transfer wizard flow removed. button_validate() now auto-copies demand to done quantity for zero-quantity moves on draft pickings (lines 1424-1426).
_compute_show_validate() and show_validate computed field removed from stock.picking in v19. Validate button visibility handled via XML view conditions. Any ORM references to show_validate will fail.
migration_flags.evidence: stock/models/stock_picking.py — full file grep returns no match for show_validate

migration_flags.description: Backorder creation policy (ask/always/never) is on stock.picking.type.create_backorder (line 133), not on stock.picking itself. Migration must ensure picking types carry this setting.

key_findings.state_machine: 6 states (draft/waiting/confirmed/assigned/done/cancel) all computed from move states; partially_available move state maps to assigned picking state
key_findings.backorder_creation: _create_backorder copies picking and re-links remaining moves; backorder_id FK set at creation; if reservation_method=at_confirm backorder is immediately reserved
key_findings.date_done: Written by _action_done at fields.Datetime.now() (line 1281); also propagated from picking.write if date_done is set manually on a done picking
key_findings.reference_ids: Many2many to stock.reference via move_ids.reference_ids — replaces procurement.group entirely; stock.reference has name char and move_ids M2M
key_findings.procurement_group: REMOVED — model not found anywhere in stock addon v19
key_findings.immediate_transfer: REMOVED — no field or method; zero-demand moves handled inline in button_validate
key_findings.scheduled_date: Computed from move dates: min for direct shipping policy, max for one/all-at-once policy
key_findings.action_assign: Auto-confirms draft before reserving; sorts moves by priority desc, deadline, date; calls stock.move._action_assign()
key_findings.post_incoming_trigger: _trigger_assign() called after incoming/internal _action_done to cascade reservation downstream
